summary: Iteration 160: Comprehensive testing of Naukri Regex Parser improvements. All 34 backend tests passed (100%). Tested concatenated header parsing, labeled format parsing, immediate joiner/serving notice detection, headline/summary extraction with fallbacks, education boundary parsing, Indian city fallback, notice period false positive prevention, and admin/recruiter routing.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ _parse_naukri_header() correctly extracts CTC from '₹ XX Lacs' format (tested Lacs and Crore)
✅ Expected CTC correctly parsed from '(expects: ₹ YY Lacs)' pattern
✅ Location extracted from city name between CTC and 'Current' keyword
✅ Notice period extracted from 'since Jan 2020 3 Months' pattern in header
✅ Experience years extracted from 'Save{N}y₹' pattern
✅ Labeled patterns ('Notice Period: X Months') correctly parsed and take PRIORITY over header values
✅ 'Current CTC: 45 Lacs' labeled format correctly parsed to 4500000
✅ 'Expected CTC: 60 Lacs' labeled format correctly parsed to 6000000
✅ 'Current Location: Gurugram' labeled format correctly parsed
✅ Immediate Joiner detection works ('Immediate', 'Immediately Available')
✅ Serving Notice detection works ('Currently Serving Notice', 'Serving Notice Period')
✅ Resume Headline extraction works with proper section boundaries
✅ Profile Summary extraction works with proper section boundaries
✅ Headline fallback synthesizes from designation + company when explicit headline missing
✅ Summary fallback synthesizes from designation + company + experience when explicit summary missing
✅ Education section correctly parsed without including certifications
✅ Indian city fallback (100+ cities) finds city names from text when no label exists
✅ Notice Period does NOT falsely match 'X Years Y Months' experience patterns
✅ Admin (admin@vhc.in) routes to regex parser (zero LLM cost)
✅ Non-admin (recruiter) routes to Claude Haiku 4.5 via direct Anthropic SDK
seed_data_creation: None - used test fixtures with sample Naukri profile text
context_for_next_testing_agent: Naukri Regex Parser (naukri_regex_parser.py) fully tested. Key improvements verified: 1) _parse_naukri_header() handles concatenated format '{name}Save{years}y₹ XX Lacs (expects: ₹ YY Lacs){City}Current{Title}...{N} Months'. 2) Labeled patterns ALWAYS take priority over header-parsed values for notice period. 3) INDIAN_CITIES set (100+ cities) enables location fallback. 4) Headline/Summary fallback synthesis from designation+company+experience. 5) Notice parser excludes 'X Years Y Months' false positives. Admin users route to regex (zero cost), non-admin to Claude.
